perks.name: Rapid Hit
perks.description: Rapid precision hits temporarily increase stability and reload speed.

perks.name: Perpetual Motion
perks.description: This weapon gains bonus stability, handling, and reload speed while the wielder is in motion.

perks.name: Outlaw
perks.description: Precision kills greatly decrease reload time.

perks.name: Moving Target
perks.description: Increased movement speed and target acquisition when moving while aiming down sights.

perks.name: Offhand Strike
perks.description: Final blows grant additional weapon range, stability, and accuracy when firing from the hip for a short duration.

perks.name: Under-Over
perks.description: Deals bonus damage to targets with overshields. Deals a small amount of bonus damage to combatant shields.

perks.name: Discord
perks.description: Final blows with another weapon grant this weapon increased speed for aiming down sights, accuracy, and airborne effectiveness for a short time. When Discord is active, final blows refund ammo.

perks.name: Kinetic Tremors
perks.description: Sustained kinetic damage to a target emits a shockwave that damages any nearby targets.

perks.name: Headseeker
perks.description: Body shots landed with this weapon increase precision damage and aim assist for a short time. Body shots landed while the perk is active refresh the time.

perks.name: Kill Clip
perks.description: Reloading after a kill grants increased damage.

perks.name: Desperado
perks.description: Reloading after a precision final blow or after rapidly defeating targets increases your rate of fire.

perks.name: Harmony
perks.description: Final blows with other weapons improve this weapon's damage and performance for a short duration.

perks.name: Encore
perks.description: Final blows grant a stacking stability, range, and accuracy bonus to this weapon. Precision final blows grant more stacks.

perks.name: Keep Away
perks.description: Increases reload, range, and accuracy when no targets are in close proximity.
